body.statement: Can one construct a total feasible estimator and confidence interval that attain the exact asymptotic minimax constants for conditional mean squared error and uniformly honest conditional expected length at every intersection of the treated-mean and fixed-design optimal-recovery channels in the repaired class \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}\), while estimating the full donor covariance \(\Sigma\) and accommodating calendar dependence?  The proposed handle is the ordered modulus of the joint treated-outcome, replicated fixed-design regression, and covariance-standardized donor-location product experiment.
body.justification: Rate comparison does not determine the joint least-favorable experiment or its exact constants at channel intersections.
body.gap: The repaired fixed-design optimal-recovery frontier leaves simultaneous exact constants with generated donor locations and calendar dependence unresolved.
body.consumer: An exact solution would calibrate sampling allocation and interval length at boundaries between replication and proxy-location difficulty.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct, or rule out, one total data-measurable estimator and one uniformly conditionally honest interval attaining the exact asymptotic minimax mean-squared-error and expected-length constants at simultaneous treated-mean, fixed-design recovery, and donor-location intersections.  This requires an exact ordered modulus for the joint conditional experiment, including the contribution of the unrestricted within-unit dependence between training responses and treated event outcomes and the full donor covariance \(\Sigma\).
obligation.obstruction: Design-conditional centering excludes the former common-design-shock witness, but the class does not impose a positive or convergent conditional treated-outcome variance or a limiting calendar long-run variance.  The rate modulus therefore does not identify an exact local asymptotic experiment or phase-intersection constant; obtaining one requires a new least-favorable-experiment argument rather than an added Gaussian or stabilized-variance assumption.
obligation.attempted: Factor the donor sample from the joint panel using \texttt{lem:sigma-field-factorization}, then use the joint modulus \(\Omega_X\) as the ordered modulus and invert least-favorable tests.  This closes only up to fixed multiplicative constants: the available mean-square and Mahalanobis budgets upper-bound or lower-bound statistical distances through non-sharp inequalities for the allowed bounded, heteroscedastic laws.  A second route replaces the calendar component by the explicit beta-mixing block concentration radius in \texttt{def:honest-interval}; that produces uniform coverage but is conservative because the coupling union bound and bounded-range correction are not an exact local limit experiment.  Estimating \(\Sigma\) under the fourth-moment condition addresses covariance geometry but does not identify the missing response likelihood and calendar long-run covariance.
obligation.partial_result:
The rate problem is complete.  By \texttt{thm:conditional-frontier}, for \(0<\lambda\le1\) the conditional minimax mean squared error is bounded above and below, under its stated converse-only class-richness condition, by fixed multiples of
\[
R_{X,\mathrm{opt}}=\left\{\sum_{s=1}^{S}\frac{\pi_s^2}{n_s}\right\}\vee\Omega_X(1;z_0,\Sigma)^2.
\]
The total nearest-design estimator supplies the upper witness without the lower-modulus premise.  By \texttt{thm:honest-length-frontier}, the accepted total concentration interval has asymptotic uniform conditional coverage at least \(1-\alpha\) and conditional expected length at most \(C R_\star^{1/2}\), while every uniformly conditionally honest interval has expected length at least \(cR_\star^{1/2}\) under the stated converse-only condition.  Thus all rates, the oracle/generated-proxy phase boundary, full-covariance donor geometry, total fallbacks, and the geometric-mixing logarithmic spacing penalty are established.  What remains is only the exact constant and an attaining exact-constant procedure at channel intersections.
